claim: Traveller-favourite beach ranking: Turtle Sanctuary 4.7 (389), Long Beach 3.9 (764), Teluk Keke 4.6 (75), Coral Bay 4.3 — small calm beaches outrank busy Long Beach.
quote: Turtle Sanctuary Beach ... 4.7 of 5 bubbles ... 389 ... Long Beach ... 3.9 of 5 bubbles ... 764 ... Teluk Keke ... 4.6 ... 75

claim: Coral Bay is the quieter west-facing beach with excellent sunsets and reef a short swim out; late-March–June dodges Aug–Sep crowds.
quote: Coral Bay provides a more relaxed atmosphere with excellent sunset views and snorkeling opportunities ... best time to go ... is between late March and June ... dry season but you won't have to deal with as many other tourists

claim: Long Beach is the lively hub with bars and fire shows; Coral Bay is a short walk west; Romantic Beach has colourful corals; Turtle Point near-guarantees turtles.
quote: Long Beach ... the island's main hub, with lively beach bars, fire shows ... Turtle Point: almost guaranteed to spot turtles ... Coral Bay offers golden hues reflect beautifully off the calm waters

claim: Inter-island water-taxi ~RM15-25; snorkel gear ~RM20/day; guided half-day snorkel ~RM30-40; Teluk Pauh a snorkel launch point; petty theft rising.
quote: Inter-island transport: around 15-25 MYR ... Gear rental at 20 MYR per day; guided half-day trips around 30-40 MYR per person ... Popular snorkeling sites: Teluk Pauh, Shark Point, Tanjung Basi

claim: Windmill Point is ~30 min uphill from Long Beach with panoramic northern-coast views; the loop to Adam & Eve, Turtle Beach and D'Lagoon is moderate ~2-2.5h.
quote: After a mere 30 minutes in the jungle we reached its panoramic views ... jaw-dropping angles of Kecil's northern coastline ... Turtle Beach ... meant to rival Adam & Eve beach as being the most beautiful on the island

claim: Marine life includes turtles, blue-spotted rays and blacktip reef sharks; a lighthouse snorkel involves climbing and jumping in; Besar has a sea-to-summit circle hike.
quote: huge sea turtles, clownfish, big blue-spotted rays and black-tipped reef sharks ... climbing and jumping off of a tall lighthouse and into the deep sea below ... circle hike from sea to summit and back again

claim: Romantic Beach has the most colourful corals; Adam & Eve is secluded golden sand; Seabelle Rock lighthouse is a boat-only snorkel drop with stronger currents.
quote: Most fish ... and corals were also the most colourful ... golden sand with no living person in sight ... Seabelle Rock Lighthouse ... currents are stronger ... you can easily hurt yourself on the rocks and shells

claim: Shark Point sits at the southern tip of Perhentian Besar off Flora Bay; blacktip reef sharks at the drop-off plus turtles; confident swimmers can shore-enter ~400-500m.
quote: blacktip reef sharks that are often seen around the drop-off ... Confident swimmers can enter the water east of Flora Bay beach, and snorkel along the rocks to the spot

claim: Teluk Keke on Besar's SW coast has free shore access, abundant ocellaris clownfish, calm sheltered water — but many sea urchins.
quote: free shore access ... known for its abundance of clownfish, especially ocellaris clownfish ... be careful though with the many sea urchins living on the seabed

claim: Named beaches per island; Kampung Pasir Hantu is the only settlement with school/mosque; coral decline and plastic pollution are serious problems.
quote: the only local settlement in the islands with facilities like a school, mosque, police station etc. ... many coral reefs have died, and plastic pollution ... has become a serious problem

claim: Kampung Pasir Hantu (9.87 ha, ~1,300 people, ~80% tourism) has a mosque, schools, clinic; six nesting beaches; ~50 coral species; jetties at Teluk Pauh & Teluk Keke.
quote: a primary school and a kindergarten, a mosque, a government health clinic, a post office, a community hall, a fire station ... Fifty species of corals have been found around Pulau Perhentian

claim: Both endangered green (Chelonia mydas) and critically-endangered hawksbill (Eretmochelys imbricata) turtles inhabit the Perhentians; visitors can submit photos for ID.
quote: Green Sea Turtle (Chelonia mydas) - Listed as Endangered ... Hawksbill Turtle (Eretmochelys imbricata) - Listed as Critically Endangered ... Send us your turtle photographs from your visit

claim: Perhentian Marine Park is the second most important offshore rookery in Peninsular Malaysia with 350-500 nests/year; peak green-turtle nesting May-July.
quote: the second most important offshore rookery in Peninsular Malaysia, with 350-500 nests per year ... peak season for nesting green turtles

claim: Islands open March-October and essentially shut Nov-early-March for the NE monsoon; best visibility April-August up to 20-30m; peak crowds Jul-Sep.
quote: The islands are officially open from March to October ... Perhentian Island is closed from November to early March due to the monsoon season ... Best Visibility: April to August (up to 20-30 meters)

claim: The Crystal Mosque (Masjid Kristal) in Kuala Terengganu, built of steel/glass/crystal and opened 2008, sits in the Islamic Heritage Park.
quote: The Crystal Mosque is located in the Islamic Heritage Park ... constructed primarily from steel, glass, and crystal ... officially opened on February 8, 2008

claim: Terengganu has no UNESCO World Heritage Site; KT Chinatown is nominated/tentative; Lake Kenyir is SE Asia's largest man-made lake; Masjid Hiliran is ~200 years old.
quote: Chinatown has been nominated for entry into UNESCO's world heritage list ... Masjid Hiliran is about 200 years old and was declared a national heritage site in 2019 ... Kenyir Lake, the largest man-made lake in Southeast Asia

claim: Mid-2026 exchange rate is about RM1 = EUR 0.213 (~RM4.7 per euro).
quote: The mid-market MYR to EUR rate is RM1 = EUR0.2132

claim: Perhentian water is glass-clear; instructors spot sea turtles 20 ft below from the boat; green and hawksbill turtles and blacktip sharks are common.
quote: The water in this area of the world is glass clear—so much so that halfway to a dive site, instructors have spotted sea turtles 20 feet below the waves

claim: Shark Point is on the south side of Besar, the best place to see blacktip sharks; the Sugar Wreck is a 90m cargo ship lying on its side in 18m.
quote: Shark Point is located on the south side of Perhentian Besar ... best place to see blacktip sharks ... The Sugar Wreck (MV Union Star 17) ... a 90m cargo ship that lies on its side in 18m of water

claim: Shore snorkelling spots range from easy entries to boat-only; Shark Point has habituated blacktip sharks 3-5m with green turtles; gear/tours info.
quote: habituated blacktip reef sharks cruising near coral bommies, while green turtles glide through clear water ... easy shore snorkeling with direct reef access from beaches on Perhentian Kecil and Besar

claim: Long Beach is the most famous beach and main hub of Kecil — powdery white sand, dive schools, restaurants, nightlife and fire shows.
quote: Long Beach is the most famous beach on the Perhentian Islands and the main hub of activity on Kecil ... majority of dive schools, restaurants, and accommodation

claim: Coral Bay is the designated sunset point where people gather on the sand or rocky outcrops; cafés run beach-cinema movie screenings.
quote: Coral Bay ... is the island's designated 'sunset point' ... many restaurants setting up 'beach cinemas' where they project movies onto large screens

claim: Coral Bay (Teluk Aur) is named for the coral in its shallow water and is a top sunset and snorkelling spot on Kecil's west side.
quote: Coral Bay sits on the western side of Kecil and is named after the abundant coral visible in the shallow waters just offshore

claim: Turtle Sanctuary Beach on Besar has white squeaky sand and buoy-protected coral; sea turtles seen regularly, best after 16:30 when boats leave.
quote: white squeaky sand and very good snorkeling, with buoys protecting the coral area ... Sea turtles can be spotted regularly, best seen after 4:30 when boats have left

claim: The Windmill viewpoint at the NE end of Kecil has a 500+ step stairwell to a sunken jetty that becomes dilapidated with broken/missing steps.
quote: a 500+ step stairwell taking you to an old, sunken jetty ... a quarter of the way down it becomes heavily dilapidated with broken or missing steps

claim: November to March is monsoon season when most island services are closed.
quote: November to March is the monsoon season in Perhentian Islands and most of the services are closed

claim: The Crystal Mosque is part of the Islamic Heritage Park, which showcases replicas of famous mosques (Taj Mahal, Masjid al-Haram, Al-Hambra).
quote: The Crystal Mosque is part of a larger tourist attraction, the Islamic Heritage Park, which showcases various replicas of other famous mosques

claim: The Perhentians are part of conservative Muslim Terengganu; the village settlement is a local fishing community.
quote: Perhentian Island, Pulau Perhentian, Perhentian Kecil & Besar, Kuala Besut, Terengganu, Malaysia

claim: Teluk Dalam (Flora Bay) on Besar's south is a long sandy family-oriented beach whose tourism now rivals Long Beach.
quote: Teluk Dalam beach is a long sandy beach ... also popularly known as 'Flora Bay' ... has grown to rival Perhentian Kecil's famous Long Beach, but it caters more for families and groups

claim: Private snorkel boat charters (Mat & Man, Coral Bay) sell out on school holidays and weekends — early booking advised.
quote: early booking is strongly encouraged, as private slots are always full, especially during school holidays and weekends

claim: Beach-hopping the Perhentians is best in the calm dry months; beaches range from busy to untouched.
quote: Best beaches in Perhentian island

claim: The Sugar Wreck and other Perhentian dive sites remain popular; reefs and wrecks make easy adventure diving.
quote: Diving the Perhentian Islands ... Reefs, Wrecks & Easy Adventure

claim: The Perhentian Turtle Project (est. 2015) is based at the village on Kecil and the Tiga Ruang nesting beach on Besar.
quote: based in two different locations: the village (Kampung Pasir Hantu) on the small island and Tiga Ruang (the nesting beach) on the big island

claim: Turtle Bay/Beach on Besar is a serene white-sand retreat fringed by coastal jungle with clear turtle-inhabited water.
quote: The white-sand beaches are fringed by lush coastal jungle, and lead down to clear waters inhabited by turtles and reef fish

claim: Teluk Keke on Besar's SW is calm and unspoiled with impressive boulders at one end and offshore coral reefs.
quote: Teluk Keke lies on the southwest coast of Perhentian Besar ... very calm and peaceful air ... impressive boulders at one end

claim: Teluk Keke is a peaceful, unspoiled snorkelling beach on Besar reached mainly by speedboat taxi.
quote: Connectivity to other beaches would mainly be by speedboat taxi ... lots of untouched and unspoiled nature all around it

claim: Peak season (Jul-Sep) is the busiest; different Perhentian beaches suit different travellers from party to seclusion.
quote: The Best Perhentian Islands Beach for You

claim: The Perhentians' core appeal is diving, snorkelling and beaches rather than built attractions.
quote: Perhentian Islands Guide 2026: Diving & Beach Paradise

claim: The Perhentians are a beach-and-water destination; the main draw is the marine environment.
quote: Perhentian Islands in Malaysia: Your Ultimate 2026 Travel Guide

claim: Shark Point is renowned for blacktip reef sharks seen around the drop-off, with turtles, angelfish and clownfish; max depth ~30 ft.
quote: blacktip reef sharks that are often seen around the drop-off ... maximum diving depth reaches 30 feet

claim: The Perhentian Turtle Project monitors foraging and nesting green and hawksbill turtles in the marine park.
quote: The Perhentian Islands Marine Park is home to foraging and nesting Green Turtles ... and Hawksbill Turtles

claim: The euro reference rate confirms the EUR/MYR exchange level used for price conversions in mid-2026.
quote: Malaysian ringgit (MYR) - European Central Bank euro reference exchange rates
